qualification.education_qualification: Master Degree with 50% marks and B.Ed, Integrated Post Graduate Course with 50% marks, B.Ed from NCTE recognized institution, Four years Integrated Degree with B.Ed component, MSc/MCA/ME/MTech in Computer Science with B.Ed, Bachelors/Honours Degree with 50% marks and B.Ed, Bachelors degree in Physical Education, Diploma in Physical Education, Bachelors degree in Drawing/Painting/Fine Arts with B.Ed, Intermediate Science, Matriculation with typing speed 40 WPM English / 35 WPM Hindi
qualification.details: PGT (Physics) (Regular basis): Integrated post Graduate Course from NCTE recognized university in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks OR Master Degree from a recognized university with at least 50% marks in the concerned subject. PGT (Chemistry) (Regular basis): B.Ed from NCTE recognized institution/university with at least 50% marks OR Three years integrated B.Ed – M.Ed from NCTE recognized institution/university with at least 50% marks. PGT (Biology) (Regular basis): Four years Integrated Degree with at least 50% marks from NCTE recognized institution including B.Ed Component OR Proficiency in teaching in Hindi & English medium. PGT (Maths) (Regular basis): Integrated post Graduate Course from NCTE recognized university in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks OR Master Degree from a recognized university with at least 50% marks in the concerned subject. PGT (Computer Science) (Regular basis): MSc (Computer Science/IT) / MCA from a recognized institution with at least 50% marks OR M.E. or M.Tech (Computer Science/IT) from recognized institution with at least 50% marks AND B.Ed or equivalent degree from NCTE recognized institution/university with at least 50% marks. TGT (Social Science) (Regular basis): Four years integrated degree course from NCTE recognized university with at least 50% marks in the concerned subject as well as in the aggregate including B.Ed component OR Bachelors/Honours Degree from a recognized university with at least 50% marks in concerned subject. TGT (General Science) (Regular basis): Four years integrated degree course from NCTE recognized university with at least 50% marks in the concerned subject as well as in the aggregate including B.Ed component OR B.Ed degree from a recognized University/institution with at least 50% marks. TGT (Mathematics) (Regular basis): Four years integrated degree course from NCTE recognized university with at least 50% marks in the concerned subject as well as in the aggregate including B.Ed component OR Bachelors/Honours Degree from a recognized university with at least 50% marks in concerned subject. TGT (English) (Regular basis): Four years integrated degree course from NCTE recognized university with at least 50% marks in the concerned subject as well as in the aggregate including B.Ed component OR Bachelors/Honours Degree from a recognized university with at least 50% marks in concerned subject. PEM/PTI-Cum-Matron (Contractual basis) (Female Only): Bachelors degree in Physical Education from a recognized university/institution OR Diploma in Physical Education from a recognized University/institution. Art Master (Contractual basis): Four years integrated degree course from NCTE recognized university with at least 50% marks OR Bachelors degree in Drawing and Painting/Sculpture/Graphic Art/Fine Arts from a recognized institution/university with at least 50% marks AND B.Ed degree from a recognized University/institution with at least 50% marks. Lab Assistant (Biology) (Contractual basis): Intermediate Science or equivalent with concerned subject from the recognized board. Lower Division Clerk (LDC) (Contractual basis): Matriculation or equivalent from a recognized board or university. Typing speed (English-40WPM & Hindi-35 WPM) in MSword/online typing tool.

salary_details.details: PGT Posts: Pay level-08 (Rs 47,600 - 1,51,100) + DA TGT Posts: Pay level-07 (Rs 44,900 - 1,42,400) + DA PEM/PTI-Cum-Matron (Contractual basis): Rs. 40,000/- (Consolidated) Art Master (Contractual basis): Rs. 70,500/- (Consolidated) Lab Assistant (Biology) (Contractual basis): Rs. 30,000/- (Consolidated) Lower Division Clerk (LDC) (Contractual basis): Rs. 30,000/- (Consolidated)

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Sainik School Sambalpur recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the Sainik School Sambalpur recruitment is 07 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 14 vacancies for PGT, TGT, and Support Staff posts announced by Sainik School Sambalpur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years and the maximum age limit is 50 years for all the posts.

faq.question: Q4. Are there any age relaxations for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided: 5 years for SC/ST candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC candidates is Rs. 500.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for SC/ST candidates is Rs. 250.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test, Class Demonstration, Skill/Practical Test, Interview, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q9. What is the highest salary offered in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The highest salary offered is Rs. 1,51,100 per month for PGT posts, plus DA.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Sainik School Sambalpur, www.sainikschoolsambalpur.edu.in.
